newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Nov trade deficit falls to $303 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Nov trade deficit falls to $303 mln.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit fell to a provisional $303 million in November from $452 million in October, compared to $342 million in November 1995, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
Exports decreased 1.2 percent to a provisional $658 million in November from $666 million in October, but increased 4.8 percent compared to $628 million in November 1995.
Imports decreased 14 percent to $961 million in November from $1.118 billion in October and 0.9 percent compared to $970 million in November 1995.

The trade gap fell to a provisional $1.511 billion in the first five months of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) from $1.745 billion in the year-ago period. Main exports were cotton yarn, fabrics, garments and rice. Main imports were machinery and petroleum products. -- Tahir Ikram 9251-274757
